modules.name: Society Manager Setup and Change
modules.description: Lets the Raghuvir Admin create or replace the Society Manager for a project and handles the handover of access and pending work.

requirements.title: Admin creates or replaces Society Manager
requirements.description: Raghuvir Admin can create or replace the Society Manager by entering name, mobile and project.

requirements.title: Transfer pending items to new Society Manager
requirements.description: When a Society Manager is replaced, pending approvals and complaint checks move to the new Society Manager.

requirements.title: Keep history with the project
requirements.description: All history stays with the project and not with the person who held the Society Manager role.

rules.title: Old Society Manager loses access at once
rules.description: When a Society Manager is replaced, the old Society Manager loses access immediately.
